'''Johanna's Glameow''' (Japanese: '''アヤコのニャルマー''' ''Ayako's Nyarmar'') is a {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} owned by [[Johanna]].

==History==
[[File:Johanna and Glameow.png|thumb|left|250px|Glameow and Johanna]]
Glameow first appeared in ''[[DP001|Following A Maiden's Voyage!]]'' and appears to be the family's pet. However, when Johanna was younger, Glameow was used in many [[Pokémon Contest]]s, having helped her to win the [[Grand Festival]] and become a [[Top Coordinator]]. It is seen in many of the pictures at {{an|Dawn}}'s house competing in Contests alongside Johanna and accepting Contest trophies. It is also seen with Johanna when she watches Dawn compete in Contests.

Johanna has a specific [[Poffin]] recipe for Glameow which Dawn has assisted her in making, mentioned in ''[[DP025|Oh Do You Know The Poffin Plan!]]''. Dawn, however, did not realize that this recipe was only made with Glameow in mind, which tasted horrible to her first three Pokémon. {{MTR}}, on the other hand, found it to be delicious.

In a flashback in ''[[DP095|Battling the Generation Gap!]]'', Glameow was revealed to have lost a battle against [[Lila]]'s {{p|Delcatty}} by points.

[[File:Johanna Glameow Umbreon.png|thumb|left|250px|Glameow and Umbreon]]
In ''[[DP138|Strategy Begins at Home!]]'', Glameow battled alongside {{p|Umbreon}} against [[Dawn's Piplup]] and {{TP|Dawn|Pachirisu}} in a [[Double Battle|two-on-two]] [[Contest Battle]]. Johanna's Pokémon eventually won the match.

In ''[[DP141|Challenging a Towering Figure!]]'', Glameow and Umbreon briefly performed at the beginning of the [[Festival Battle Challenge]], much to the delight of the attendees.

In ''[[DP167|Teaching the Student Teacher!]]'', Glameow assisted its owner with teaching at a Trainer's School.

Glameow appeared alongside Johanna during the ending credits of ''[[M13|Zoroark: Master of Illusions]]''.

In [[DPS01]], Glameow battled Dawn's Piplup and {{TP|Dawn|Cyndaquil}} alongside Umbreon. It was able to do some dazzling combinations with Umbreon, but when Piplup and Cyndaquil unleashed their {{m|Whirlpool}}-{{m|Flame Wheel}} combination, the battle was stopped due to them fighting.
{{-}}
==Personality and characteristics==
From Glameow's debut in ''[[DP001|Following A Maiden's Voyage!]]'', it showed many characteristics of a common house cat, appearing quite lazy and docile. It appeared to like {{an|Dawn}}, its Trainer's daughter, even watching her as she rode off on her journey. 

Later in ''[[DP138|Strategy Begins at Home!]]'', Glameow, along with Johanna's Umbreon, acted very distant with [[Dawn's Piplup]], not accepting the new member of its family. Johanna later mentioned that it and Umbreon are usually very picky eaters, while they ate the food that {{an|Brock}} made. This reflects their initial response to meeting Piplup, not being too accepting of the new.

===Pokémon Adventures===
===={{MangaArc|HeartGold & SoulSilver}}====

===={{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}====
Glameow first appeared as a cameo in ''[[PS351|Perturbed by Pachirisu]]'', when {{adv|Platinum|Lady Berlitz}} was watching recordings of past {{pkmn|Super Contest}}s featuring Johanna and Glameow.

Glameow also appeared in ''[[PS395|Stopping Sableye]]'', ''[[PS400|Bogging Down Quagsire]]'', and ''[[PS403|Cleaning Up Grimer]]'' as a pet Pokémon in {{adv|Diamond}}'s house.
